sources.title: How to Run Ornith 1.5 35B Locally: GGUF, Hardware and Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Ornith 1.5 35B is the strongest model from DeepReinforce's new Ornith 1.5 family that you can run on a desktop: a 35B MoE with 3B active parameters that fits on a 24 GB GPU or a 32 GB Mac at 4-bit quantization. This guide covers our Atomic Dynamic GGUF builds, how much memory each one needs, and the exact setup for both Atomic Chat and llama.cpp.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5 extends the self-scaffolding framework introduced in Ornith-1.0 into a more complete self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for reinforcement learning, continuously creating new learning experiences from which it can improve.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B Benchmarks & Context (August 2026) | BenchLM.ai
sources.snippet: These notes preserve the model, ranking, coverage, and family context behind the numbers. Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B ranks #137 of 224 on the public leaderboard with a score of 49.22/100. It does not yet have enough sourced coverage for a verified position. Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B is a open weight model with a 262K context window.
